Mod.name: Backup Wand
Mod.description: Adds a second wand holding a single spell called BACKUP.\n\nCast it to create a copy of yourself (a full duplicate of your wands, spells, perks and items as they were at that moment). Only one copy can exist at a time. Cast it again to recall the existing copy to you. If you die while a copy exists, you do not die: you instead take control of your copy, waking up where it stood with everything it was carrying. The BACKUP spell costs no mana and can be cast forever.
